# AIPromptNest

> AIPromptNest is a free library of curated AI prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other large language models. Browse, copy and use ready-made prompts organized by category.

Site: https://www.aipromptnest.com
Contact: hello.aipromptnest@gmail.com

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.aipromptnest.com/): Featured and latest prompts
- [Browse Prompts](https://www.aipromptnest.com/browse): Search and filter the full prompt library
- [Categories](https://www.aipromptnest.com/categories): Prompts grouped by topic
- [Trending](https://www.aipromptnest.com/trending): Most popular prompts
- [Discover](https://www.aipromptnest.com/discover): Discover new prompts
- [Blog](https://www.aipromptnest.com/blog): Guides and tips on prompt engineering
- [FAQ](https://www.aipromptnest.com/faq): Frequently asked questions
